notes.title: Patch notes for 10/7 update
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes for the latest update.

Localization/Localized UI:
•	Multiple fixes and translation improvements for Japanese and Korean language version

Tech/Code:
•	Fixed reflective surface performance
•	Fix for black corruption causing performance issues 
•	Fix for PC Performance staying between 90-100MS across the game 
•	Improved performance in a few sections when using DX11 cloth physics
•	Fix for corrupted textures early in game
•	Fix for doors to decontamination chamber not loading when re-loading checkpoint in Xbase Visit 1 
•	Fix for light and shadow errors caused by camera positioning in the University and Silo levels
